title: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Behavioral Disorders and Emotional Disturbances (5372) - 200 Source Questions + 300 Independent Practice Questions
description: Contains 200 original source questions, 300 assistant-authored independent practice questions, and 0 source-derived guided-review activities. Two 100-item diagnostics, an exact-blueprint 120-item simulation, detailed feedback, and native learning support for K-12 EBD specialists.
contentReview: Assistant audit completed: 500 independent-practice items contain 472 distinct content kernels and 28 parallel variants under the normalized test. 0 additional activities are guided reasoning transformations, not independent exam questions.
